newsitem.title: ITALY: Snia Fibre sees Q1 profits, merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Snia Fibre sees Q1 profits, merger approved.

text.p: Italian chemicals and fibres group Snia Fibre returned to profit in the first quarter of 1997 with a pretax profit of three billion lire after a one billion lire loss in Q1 1996, while the group's shareholders approved its merger with Snia BPD.

Snia Fibre said in a note on Friday after its shareholders meeting to approve the merger that its Q1 1997 sales rose to 263 billion lire from 250 billion lire, while it showed operating profits of 11 billion lire after 10 billion lire.
Snia BPD already owns 83.68 percent of Snia Fibre, and in the merger Snia Fibre shareholders will be offered two new Snia BPD shares for each five old Snia Fibre shares they hold.

For those Snia Fibre shareholders not wanting Snia BPD shares, they can receive a fixed price of 612.67 lire for each of their shares. At 1330 GMT, Snia Fibre shares were at 550 lire from Thursday's close of 530.7 lire.
